svg.title: Figure 4-1 · Validation targets on a log scale
svg.desc: Two log-scale panels with one row per validation target VT-01 to VT-15. Left: driving exposure in km (hours at 64 km/h); VT-01 rate-level needs about 6 × 10^5 mi (case D), VT-04 and VT-15(b) need about 3 × 10^3 km and 3 h. The public-road band of 10^4 to 2 × 10^4 km per year is below case D and far below cases A to C. Right: counts per scenario, from 14 to 299, inside or near the closed-course band (tens to low hundreds) and below the simulation band (10^3 to 10^5 runs, no credit yet). VT-07 to VT-11 have no exposure figure. All values are placeholders until assessor approval.
svg.text: Figure 4-1 · Validation targets on a log scale
